title: Pixieset Website Builder | Photography Website, Portfolio & Blog

facts.fact: Pixieset describes its Website product as a builder for photography websites, portfolios, or blogs.
facts.quote: Pixieset makes it fun and easy to build a stunning photography website, portfolio or blog that stands out online.

facts.fact: The template filter categories shown on the page are Business websites, Portfolios, and One-pagers.
Pixieset's site navigation lists six products beyond its website builder: Client Gallery, Studio Manager, Store, Mobile Gallery app, and Photo Editor.
facts.quote: AI editing and culling for photographers
